name: local-build
title_zh: Arc A770 本地显卡跑代码任务
tagline_zh: 把改文件、跑测试这类边界清楚的活儿丢给本地显卡，省线上额度、免数据出机。三个档位：长窗、快读、重推理，按活选。
tagline_en: Offload bounded coding chores to your local GPU—save online quota, keep data in-house. Three profiles.
desc_en: Dispatch a coding task to the LOCAL builder model on the Arc A770 (llama.cpp Vulkan, opencode seat) instead of an online LLM seat. Three profiles — long (Qwen3.5-9B, the default, a 262k window), fast (Gemma 4 E4B, the reader) and serious (Qwen3.8-27B IQ3_XXS). Use for bounded, well-specified work the calling agent chooses to delegate: a small change to named files, tests from a specification, the
why_zh: 不是简单调 llama.cpp——它把 opencode 座位接到本地 Vulkan 推理上。
why_en: Not just llama.cpp glue—it seats opencode on local Vulkan inference, so the caller delegates deliberately. Saves real.
limit_zh: 只吃边界清楚、规格明确的活：改指定文件、按规格跑测试。开放式探索、跨模块重构、需要联网查证的活它不接。
limit_en: Only takes bounded, well-specified tasks: named-file edits, spec-driven tests. Open-ended exploration, cross-module refactors, or web-verification.
title_en: Run coding tasks on your Arc A770, not an online LLM seat
